title: Normative Evaluation of Large Language Models with Everyday Moral Dilemmas

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting LLMs with over 10,000 everyday moral dilemmas from the Reddit 'Am I the Asshole' (AITA) community to assign blame verdicts and provide reasoning, then comparing the models' verdict distributions, inter-model agreement, and reliance on specific moral themes against human (Redditor) consensus.

Analyzing the alignment of LLM moral judgments with those of Redditors to demonstrate how AI systems may disproportionately reflect the values of WEIRD (Western, Educated, Industrialized, Rich, and Democratic) subpopulations rather than universal human ethics.
